label: Power and the two errors
subgoals: Write power as one minus beta

visual.title: A larger effect moves the alternative
visual.caption: The alternative curve is centred at the true effect. Moving it farther from zero puts more of its area inside the rejection region, so power rises without changing alpha.

predict.question: Holding alpha fixed, which change raises power?
predict.explain: A larger true effect shifts the alternative farther into the rejection region. A smaller sample or a stricter alpha usually lowers power.
